annotations.title: Get park weather and ride conditions

description: Use this when a visitor asks about the weather, storms, heat, lightning or weather alerts at one supported park right now, or how many rides are down. Weather is the National Weather Service's latest observation and alerts; it is current conditions, not a forecast.

park_id.description: Park key (magic-kingdom), canonical park ID, park name, or shorthand such as mk, epcot, hs, ak, dl, dca, usf, ioa, epic or ush. A park name works directly, with no lookup first.
